notes.title: Yearly Big Update
notes.content:
There it is the huge update I promised you guys.

Whats new:

[olist]
[*] Map Changes:
[list]
[*] Deleted all previous maps
[*] New bigger map created
[*] Added Half Nexus in the middle of the map
[*] Added Neutral Orc camp to the Map
[*] Added 4 Abbility Points to the Map
[*] Added two additional Paths to the Map
[*] Added Birds flying in the Sky
[*] Added Upgrade Shops
[/list]
[*] Half Nexus:
[list]
[*] Can Spawn Units at Half Nexus
[*] Fires Projectiles at the Base that isn´t controlling it every minute
[/list]

[*] Abbilities:

[*] Character gains abbility points (Yellow Bar)
[*] Character can choose 4 abbilities at the Upgrade Shop

[list]

[*] Orders:
[list]
[*] Added Order Hold
[*] Added Attack Main Path
[*] Added Attack Right Path
[*] Added Attack Left Path
[/list]

[*] Enemy AI:
[list]
[*] Added Attack Main Path
[*] Added Attack Right Path
[*] Added Attack Left Path
[/list]

[*] Units:
[list]
[*] Attacks automatically now
[/list]
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Another HUGE Update since the last update was long time ago. So I added a lot of new Units, a lot of new animations and improved the sounds of the combat to make it more realistic. Also there will be blood or sparks if a unit is hit. Further more I added a new type of building which is the income building increasing your over time income by 50 per building. 

Recruiting:
Your units will not spawn or attack automatically. You have to spawn your units using the spawn menu (Button R) and then give them the order to attack the enemy base using the Command stance (C) and the right mouse button.

Map changes:
There are less maps and the Nexus will be generated randomly if you fight against AI or depending on the race of your oponent. 
At last the newest thing is the front base in the middle of the map. If you control it an indicator will show you and your units are spawned which means its much easier to get reinforcements to the enemy base. 

New Building Types:
[list]
[*] Income Buildings. Increases the over time income by 50.
[/list]

New Units: 

Humans:
[list]
[*] Knight with lance and shield
[/list]

Orks:
[list]
[*] Orc with Helbard
[/list]

Skeletons:
[list]
[*] Skeleton Lancer
[*] Centipede: Special Unit
[/list]

New Animations:
[list]
[*] New spear and shield animations
[*] New sword and shield animations
[/list]

Maps:
[*] Two new maps with random nexus
[*] Frontbase to spawn your units

Improvements:
[list]
[*] Improved path finding of AI
[*] Improved animation hit sounds
[*] Added hit indicator
[*] Improved Online stability 
[*] Small fixes to make the Game more balanced
[*] Changing of game name
[/list]

notes.title: Fighting
notes.content:
You wanted to fight among your units? I made it possible, but you should stay out of heavy fights
since if your HP goes down to 0, you lose half your gold and you can´t fight and give orders until 
your health regenerates a bit.

Further Changes:

[list]
[*] Added controls menu
